known_gray_zone.note: `_scalar_lt` falls back to comparing `repr(a) < repr(b)` when values are not directly orderable; this makes the sort total but the resulting order is lexicographic-on-repr and can be surprising (e.g. mixed types or numbers rendered as strings), which a reviewer might flag.
